story.summaryEn:
Audmin likes to have fun. Luckily, the @Revolut Apex card almost never says no.
Get yours now: https://www.revolut.com/f1-revolut/?geo-redirect
Available to Revolut customers in the UK, EEA (except Switzerland), Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Singapore and USA.
A one-time fee applies for special edition debit cards. 18+, T&Cs apply.
Subject to availability. Product availability and licensing vary by region. Banking and card services are provided by local licensed Revolut entities or partner banks; in Portugal, services are provided by Revolut Bank UAB, registered with Banco de Portugal under No. 3560. For AU customers: consider TMD at http://revolut.com/en-AU to determine if right for you. Revolut Payments Australia (AFSL and Australian Credit Licence 517589).
detailZh:
Audmin 喜欢玩乐。幸运的是，@Revolut Apex 信用卡几乎从不拒绝。
现在就领取您的：https://www.revolut.com/f1-revolut/?geo-redirect
适用于英国、除瑞士外、澳大利亚、新西兰、日本、新加坡和美国等地的 Revolut 客户。
特别版借记卡收取一次性费用。18岁及以上，适用条款和条件。
视供应情况而定。产品可用性和许可情况因地区而异。银行和信用卡服务由当地授权的 Revolut 实体或合作伙伴银行提供；在葡萄牙，服务由 Revolut Bank UAB 提供，已在葡萄牙银行注册，注册号为 3560。对于澳大利亚客户：请考虑 TMD（http://revolut.com/en-AU）以确定是否适合您。和澳大利亚信贷许可。
